title: Overcoming strength-ductility tradeoff with high pressure thermal treatment

recollection.structure: Guess: refined grain structure or precipitate formation
recollection.mechanism: Guess: grain refinement, precipitation hardening, or dislocation density reduction

score.note: The intervention merely repeats the title and omits the specific HPHT hexahedron-anvil treatment.
